title: Check: Effect of Catalysts on Rate

questions.stem: Which statement correctly describes how a catalyst works?

options.text: It increases the energy of the reacting particles
It provides an alternative reaction pathway with a lower activation energy
It increases the temperature of the reaction mixture
It increases the concentration of the reactants

questions.explanation: A catalyst provides an alternative reaction pathway with a lower activation energy. This means more particles already have sufficient energy to react when they collide, increasing the proportion of successful collisions and therefore the rate.

questions.stem: Manganese dioxide (MnO₂) catalyses the decomposition of hydrogen peroxide. Which of the following is true about the MnO₂?

options.text: It is used up during the reaction and must be replaced
It changes the products formed in the reaction
It can be recovered unchanged at the end of the reaction
It changes the enthalpy change of the reaction

questions.explanation: A defining feature of a catalyst is that it is not used up during the reaction. The MnO₂ can be recovered by filtration after the reaction is complete, and its mass will be unchanged. It does not alter the products formed or the enthalpy change.
